test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 5% per year rate of interest for 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% per year

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (₹2500 × 5 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = ₹375

**The simple interest on ₹2500 at 5% per year for 3 years is ₹375.**
